description: A PNG of a view, framed on the query's matches, and the link to the same view. Returns the image inline. Uses the running behold serve of this project; with none, it starts behold in this process for the shot and stops it after. Needs the optional peer playwright-core and a browser; without them it refuses with the install line. Writes no file. Without a query, node or focus frames the view's own selection. The query is chant's search grammar, unchanged (https://intentius.io/chant/cli/search/). env reads that environment live (chant search --live --env <env>); snapshot with env replays a recorded snapshot instead (chant --snapshot <ref>, such as latest); chant's --explain is always on, for the near-misses drawn. It takes no --check-live or --check-snapshot (drift is not drawn), and no --ambient, --src or --fail-on-drift. Read the capabilities tool first: it lists the capabilities a cap: term asks (cap:internet-reachable(22), ->[cap=network]), each one's meaning, parameters and rule (INTENTIUS/chant#4375).

countBy.description: Group the matches the way chant search --count-by does: kind, module or attr:<name> (behold#922). The answer is chant's groups and total; the view lights each group's cards and labels the group with its count. The query may then be empty, to count the whole estate.

env.description: The environment whose live state the view shows. Without it, the declared source.

focus.description: Comma-separated box ids to keep at full weight; the rest dims.

node.description: A card to select, by behold's node id.

plan.description: The plan read (behold#922): the query is answered at the plan depth (CHANT_TERRAFORM_OBSERVE=plan, chant search --live --env), and the cards carry each Terraform root's planAction, planActions, planReplacePaths and planActionReason. On a bare Terraform folder no env is needed; on a chant project pass env. Refused with snapshot. Runs terraform plan -lock=false in each root: it changes nothing, and reads every resource.

query.description: A chant search query whose matches the view lights, such as `attr:internetFacing=true`.

snapshot.description: With env: a recorded snapshot to show instead of a live read (latest, or a ref chant lists). Not with plan.

zoom.description: The zoom: components, resources, attributes, or another behold offers.

name: shot
